model.title: A bill to take certain Federal land in the State of California into trust for the benefit of the Shingle Springs Band of Miwok Indians, and for other purposes.
model.meta: Indian Affairs Committee · Sen. Alex Padilla (D-CA)

summary.text: The bill would transfer approximately 265 acres of federal land in El Dorado County, California, to trust status for the Shingle Springs Band of Miwok Indians, combining government-managed land currently used as a Forest Service experiment station with land already owned by the tribe. The transferred land would become part of the tribe's reservation, though gaming would be prohibited on the newly trusted acreage.
